description: Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) - Closures is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Road closures around lax. Data changes over time based on the frequency of closures to lower or upper levels. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are lax, construction closures, road closures, construction alerts. The table has 25 columns. Attribution on the portal: Los Angeles World Aiports. The portal shows 2024-04-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
